test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

I cannot __sit up with__ this sort of insult in office.
solution:
The correct answer is '**put up with**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** substitute for the underlined segment '**sit up with**' is '**put up with**'.
 
• The meaning of the **phrasal verb** '**put up with**' means '**tolerate or endure something**'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is '**put up with**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are just to confuse they do not mean anything.
